text:
Noah Patel: Heads-up 1 - I'm opening a Quickstart refresh PR that consolidates Hello World across Node/Python/Go, switches auth examples to service tokens, and shows `redwood deploy` for first deploy. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4956

DocsBot: PR created by Noah Patel 1 - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4956 (status: draft)

Zoe Kim: Nice. Can we also add a tiny "when to use what credential" table? New users get confused between service tokens and user API keys.

Noah Patel: Yes, planning a 3-row table: Quick experiment -> Service token, Local/test with login -> User API key, Production -> KMS-backed rotated credential. Will add wording for least-privilege scopes.

Hannah Lee: For the Node snippet, please use the v2 streaming API (`client.chat.completions.stream`). Also explicitly show the env var as `REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN` (not REDWOOD_API_KEY).

Noah Patel: Will update. Draft Node snippet: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN });
const stream = await client.chat.completions.stream({ model: 'gpt-tiny', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello from Node' }] });
for await (const chunk of stream) process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
```

Carlos Mendez: Suggestion: include a minimal curl example for folks who want zero SDK setup. Make the Authorization header explicit.

Noah Patel: Added curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-tiny","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}'
```

Hannah Lee: For Go and Python, small streaming examples would be great. But keep Ruby/sync for its straightforwardness.

Zoe Kim: One other note: the existing private deploy link in several docs is outdated. Should point to /docs/private-deploy/vpc now. Add a short callout: "Private deployments may require extra KMS/HSM setup."

InfraBot: Reminder: linked page /docs/enterprise/private-deploy -> redirect in place but update to canonical /docs/private-deploy/vpc to avoid 404 for external readers.

Carlos Mendez: I'm volunteering to run a quick link-check sweep after the PR content lands. I'll list any broken anchors too.

Noah Patel: Thanks Carlos. Also adding a small migration blurb: "If you used SDK v1, replace `streamResponses` with `chat.completions.stream` and rename env vars to REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN." Will include a one-line diff example.

Hannah Lee: Can we add a GitHub Action to smoke-test snippets? Proposed behavior: opt-in label `run-snippet-tests` that executes node+python+go examples with a sandbox token stored in secrets. Should not run on every PR by default.

Noah Patel: Good plan. If someone can add the GH Action as a follow-up commit, I'll wire it into the PR. Also plan to add a short note in Quickstart header: "This guide is for onboarding only. For production, follow the security guide."

Zoe Kim: LGTM for content & structure. I'll do a prose pass after snippets are stable.

DocsBot: Reviewer checklist:
- [ ] Replace env var mentions with REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN (Hannah/Noah)
- [ ] Add credential recommendation table (Zoe)
- [ ] Add curl Authorization header example (Carlos/Noah)
- [ ] Update private deploy links to /docs/private-deploy/vpc + KMS callout (Noah/Carlos)
- [ ] Add migration note v1->v2 (Noah)
- [ ] Add opt-in GH Action `run-snippet-tests` (Hannah)
- [ ] Run link-check sweep after merge (Carlos)

Carlos Mendez: Assigned the link sweep. I'll post results in this thread when done.

Noah Patel: Thanks y'all. Pushing edits now; will mark PR ready once the GH Action branch is linked. :thumbsup:

InfraBot: CI hint: protect secrets by using repository-level sandbox and require PR label to allow access.

Hannah Lee: I'll open the GH Action branch and tag @Noah when it's ready.

Noah Patel: Closing loop: PR updated with code snippets, curl, credential table draft, and migration blurb. Waiting on the GH Action branch.

DocsBot: PR status: draft updated  checks: none

Zoe Kim: Thanks everyone, this will make onboarding much clearer. :party:
